technology.title: Why Cold Process? Because Heat Destroys Nature's Power
technology.hot_desc: Most commercial soaps use 100°C+ hot process. It's faster and cheaper — but it destroys the very compounds that make herbs effective. Vitamins, amino acids, and botanical actives don't survive the heat.
technology.cold_title: Our 45-Day Cold Process — The Patient Way
technology.cold_subtitle: Low Temperature. Long Saponification. Maximum Potency.
technology.cold_item2: 45 days of natural saponification — no shortcuts
technology.cold_desc: By keeping temperatures low and giving nature time to work, we create a bar that retains the full spectrum of herbal benefits. The result? A soap that cleanses, nourishes, and truly cares for hair.
technology.zero_title: 5 Zero-Additives — Not Because It's Trendy, Because It's Right
technology.zero_desc: No chemicals. No compromises. Just pure herbal soap that meets the world's strictest import standards.
technology.zero_item1_desc: No synthetic smoothing agents — natural plant-based cleansing that lets hair breathe.
technology.zero_item2_desc: No harsh surfactants — gentle enough for daily use, even on sensitive scalps.
technology.zero_item3_desc: No chemical preservatives — the cold process itself is nature's preservative.
technology.zero_item4_desc: No harsh cleansing agents — meets EU and premium market standards effortlessly.
technology.zero_item5_desc: Only the natural aroma of 18 herbs — the way traditional Miao herbalism intended.

brand_story.title: The Miao Ben Fang Story
brand_story.subtitle: Ancient Wisdom, Modern Craft
brand_story.desc:
Deep in the mountains of Guizhou, China, Miao herbalists have spent generations perfecting the art of botanical hair care. Their knowledge — 18 specific herbs, each playing a precise role — was passed down through families, not written in textbooks. 

Today, Miao Ben Fang brings this tradition to the world. We've combined centuries of Miao herbal wisdom with modern cold-process technology to create a soap that's as pure as nature intended. No heat damage. No chemical shortcuts. Just 18 herbs, 45 days of patience, and an unwavering commitment to quality.
